**Summary:** End-to-end probe of cluster <kafka_cluster> loses messages

Less than 90 % of KMinion's probe messages come back. Applications are very likely affected as well: check offline / under-min-ISR partitions and broker availability.

## Impact

Kafka does not deliver KMinion's own messages: applications are very likely affected too.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · End-to-End Probe → per-partition latency and failures (each probe partition has a different leader broker); then Cluster Overview.

## Mitigation

- Follow KafkaOfflinePartitions / KafkaUnderMinISR / KafkaBrokerDown, whichever fires.

## Expression

```promql
sum by (kafka_cluster) (rate(kminion_end_to_end_messages_received_total[5m])) / sum by (kafka_cluster) (rate(kminion_end_to_end_messages_produced_total[5m])) < 0.9
```
